envelope.description: Regenerate the shared fixture with buildSetup and show the suggestion in the terminal rows model

body.title: Regenerate the shared fixture with buildSetup and show the suggestion in the terminal rows model
body.summary: Add a buildSetup to the repo.settings.get payload of src/config/__tests__/fixtures/repo-fields-catalog.json, and make buildSettingsRows in src/cli/panes/repo-settings-model.ts show the suggestion as the placeholder of an unset Build row (a repo with commandsSource 'none' and a suggestion). Rows keep the daemon's order, labels and kinds; a payload without buildSetup behaves as before.
acceptanceChecks: The shared fixture's payload carries buildSetup and the terminal rows still equal the fixture's rows
An unset Build row of a repo with a suggestion shows the suggestion as its placeholder text
A payload with no buildSetup renders exactly as before

tests.name: src/cli/__tests__/repo-fields-contract.test.ts: the shared fixture's repo.settings.get payload carries buildSetup and the terminal rows still equal the fixture's rows
